step1_analysis.circuit_type: Small-Signal Equivalent Model of a Sense Amplifier
step1_analysis.description: A small-signal equivalent circuit modeling a high-speed current-mode sense amplifier for Bi-NOR flash memories. It includes bitline capacitances (Cs), drain capacitances (Cd), and cell/reference current sources to evaluate sensing delay and transient response.

paper_reference.title: A Novel High-Speed Sense Amplifier for Bi-NOR Flash Memories

t_sense.description: Sensing delay time for the bitline node to reach the sensing threshold.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the reported 2pF bitline capacitance and 2ns sensing time, an effective charging current of ~500uA is required to reach a 0.5V threshold.

v_bitline_max.description: Maximum voltage reached on the bitline node (V3).

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by Icell * (1/gds) in steady state, or limited by the transient window.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The bitline voltage must be kept low enough for proper cell operation, typically around 0.5V to 1V.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the sensing delay of the small-signal sense amplifier model by charging the bitline capacitance with the cell current.
